Maya (partnerships): Quick sync — we need a standard flow for systems integrator sandbox access, certification badging, and marketplace listing before any joint announcement. Who's owning sandbox gating?
Tom (solutions): We own sandbox ops for SI trials. Current flow: request form -> infra provision -> 1:1 training -> badge. Form needs updates for hardware partners + marketplace metadata.
Lina (devex): I can draft a short playbook + 5min screencast. Proposal: two tracks, 'trial' (limited access) and 'certified deliverer' (full access + badge).
Ryan (engineering): Note — private/VPC/on‑prem has extra checklist: VPN certs, KMS integration, and audit logs. Badge should auto-issue after lab completions + eval pass.
Maya (partnerships): Timeline idea: playbook draft by Wed, infra QA by Fri, soft launch to one pilot SI next Tue. Feasible?
Tom (solutions): Wed is tight but doable if we fork the marketplace onboarding template. Will need SOW + support SLA boilerplate from legal.
Jen (legal): SOW + DP clause (KMS/HSM) ready to slot in. Need to confirm whether partners can demo with customer data or must use synthetic datasets.
Lina (devex): Badging requirements suggestion: (1) complete 4 hands-on labs, (2) pass quiz >=80%, (3) perform one joint customer demo review with a Redwood rep. Badge issued via devex-badging service.
Ops-bot: Ticket created: INFRA-4821 - SI tenant provisioning checklist.
Tom (solutions): Can quizzes be shareable? We should provide an API so partners can programmatically pull cert proofs. Endpoint idea: POST /partner/badges/issue {partner_id, badge_id, proof_url} :+1:
Ryan (engineering): Example request for badge issuance: ```curl -X POST https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/partner/badges -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"partner_id":"acme-si","badge_id":"si-certified-deliverer","proof_url":"https://notion.redwood.ai/proofs/acme-si-labs"}'```
Maya (partnerships): Marketplace listing & joint announcement — marketing needs a 2-week lead. We should create a single one-pager and a recommended cadence for partner comms.
Aisha (marketing): Agree. Request a draft marketplace listing and partner one-pager by next Thu. We'll slot any joint PR into our calendar if partner approves.
Tom (solutions): Action items: Tom -> update intake form + infra checklist; Lina -> draft playbook + screencast; Ryan -> badge API + auto-issue flow; Jen -> finalize SOW clauses; Aisha -> confirm announcement windows. I'll run a 20-min sync tomorrow 9:00am PT to align.
Lina (devex): Added tasks to Notion and pinged the pilot partner intake. :white_check_mark:
Maya (partnerships): Thanks team — let's get the playbook tight and keep the pilot small. :rocket:
